paragraphs: I build production software end to end. My work spans enterprise Vue and C# .NET services on SQL Server, Postgres-backed PWAs, and AI features that real users depend on.

At OneHope, a global nonprofit serving users in 100+ countries, I made the Planning dashboard load its data 20x faster (10s to 0.5s). I also shipped a request tracer across 14 .NET repos and remediated a critical CPU-exhaustion vulnerability.

As a volunteer AI Software Engineer, I built and maintain a church PWA with RAG-based Voice AI. It answers Vietnamese questions from English PDFs with citations, backed by a failover AI microservice that kept 99.9% uptime during LLM outages.

My favorite part of the job is sitting with stakeholders. I run interviews, turn complaints into user stories and acceptance criteria, and ship against what users approved beforehand. I also led a 6-person team building an AI Follicle Detector for a university biology lab (F1 0.89).
